<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/auth/setup/dumps"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



First-run only: public, and refused with `409` once the server has any
account. Lists the scheduled-backup dumps (`famlin-<timestamp>.dump`)
already in the backups volume's `db/` folder, newest first. Interrupted
(`.partial`) and other files are left out. Rate-limited to 30 requests
per 15 minutes per IP.
